column2: Others were saying, “These are not the words of someone demon-possessed. A demon cannot open the eyes of the blind, can it?”
At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon’s colonnade.
So the Jews surrounded him and were saying to him, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name testify about me.
But you do not believe, because you are not among my sheep.
My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
I give them eternal life, and they will certainly never perish, and no one will seize them out of my hand.
My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one can seize them out of the Father’s hand.
I and the Father are one.”
